description: This file defines the VisitAttributeType class, which represents a custom extension related to visit attributes within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It manages visit attribute type metadata such as ID and description, with persistence annotations for ORM.

classes.name: VisitAttributeType
classes.description: Represents a visit attribute type in the system, extending BaseAttributeType and implementing AttributeType with persistence annotations for database mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the visit attribute type, implementing the getId method from OpenmrsObject interface.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID for the visit attribute type, implementing the setId method from OpenmrsObject interface.
